one_liner: Cloud-based customer relationship management (CRM) platform offering extensive APIs for data management, workflow automation, and metadata configuration.
agent_notes: Salesforce offers free, lifetime Developer Edition accounts for immediate testing. The developer ecosystem includes REST, GraphQL, SOAP, Bulk, Tooling, and Pub/Sub (gRPC) APIs. Multiple community-maintained Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers are available.

one_liner: Customer relationship management platform providing sales, marketing, service, content management, and operations tools.
agent_notes: HubSpot offers comprehensive REST APIs covering standard CRM objects (Contacts, Companies, Deals, Tickets), custom objects, marketing assets, automation workflows, and webhooks, alongside a GraphQL API layer. Authentication uses OAuth 2.0 or Private App tokens (legacy API keys were deprecated in Nov 2022). Developer accounts and sandboxes are free to create self-serve.

one_liner: Sales CRM and pipeline management software for tracking deals, leads, contacts, and sales activities.
agent_notes: Pipedrive offers a comprehensive REST API covering deals, leads, persons, organizations, pipelines, stages, activities, webhooks, files, and custom fields. API tokens are readily available in personal settings during the 14-day free trial or on any active subscription, and OAuth 2.0 is supported for marketplace apps.

one_liner: Modern, customizable CRM platform built around flexible data models, real-time collaboration, and developer-first REST APIs.
agent_notes: Attio offers a well-documented REST API with full CRUD capabilities across custom objects, standard records, attributes, tasks, webhooks, notes, and list entries. Supports both API keys and OAuth 2.0 authentication.

one_liner: Open-source modern CRM platform designed as a customizable alternative to Salesforce.
agent_notes: Twenty provides auto-generated REST and GraphQL APIs for all CRM objects (both standard and custom). API keys can be easily generated from the user settings panel.

one_liner: Podio is a flexible work management and CRM platform with a broad REST API for managing items, workspaces, apps, and webhooks.
agent_notes: Podio provides a comprehensive and mature REST API covering workspaces, custom apps, items, tasks, comments, and webhooks. Developer keys can be created directly from user settings.

one_liner: Cloud-based customer relationship management platform offering comprehensive sales automation, lead management, and custom modules.
agent_notes: Zoho CRM provides a mature REST API (v6) covering all standard modules (Leads, Contacts, Accounts, Deals) and custom modules. Supports COQL (CRM Object Query Language) for complex SQL-like queries, webhooks, and bulk APIs. Multi-DC (US, EU, IN, AU, JP, CA) requires handling region-specific API domain endpoints during OAuth and request routing.

agent_notes: Pylon provides a well-documented public REST API for managing issues/tickets, accounts, contacts, custom fields, and webhooks using Bearer token API key authentication.
